name: web-merch-store-responsive-showcase
title: Merch store desktop and mobile with pastel product cards
whatItIs: A long preview of a brand store with a cream hero holding a perspective row of coloured product cards, a featured collections grid with white product tiles, a keychain trio on tinted cards, category tiles, and a black footer with a giant spaced 'STORE'. A narrower mobile version sits beside it.
whatItMeans: Playful and tidy, like a museum shop; colourful product cards on a neutral page make merchandise feel collectable.
techniques: Give each product a tinted square in a different pastel to create a bright shelf.
Show the mobile and desktop layouts side by side to prove responsiveness.
Overlap a centre card larger than its neighbours in trios for focus.
End with a huge letter-spaced wordmark in the footer.

vocabulary.definition: A product on a soft coloured square.
An oversized brand name closing the page.
Desktop and mobile views shown together.
A curated grid at the top of a store.
